column1: # Wisp partition layout for ESP32-C6 4 MB flash.
# Per the wisp-OTA reconciliation doc (2026-06-04): wisp app (~1.28 MB) +
# embedded signed lamp firmware blob (~1.40 MB) + 96 B LSIG footer ≈ 2.68 MB
# so app0 needs ≥ 3 MB. No app1 because wisp does NOT self-OTA in v1.
# SPIFFS retained for future asset storage; NVS untouched.
